title: Total units sold
context: The Orders table (rows 2-41) has one row per order. Ops wants the total volume shipped.
task: How many units were sold in total across every order?
hint: Find the column that holds units per order and total it.

title: Average unit price
context: Pricing wants a sense of the typical list price charged.
task: What is the average unit price across all orders?
hint: One column holds the price each unit sold for.

title: How many orders?
context: A KPI tile needs the number of orders in the ledger.
task: How many orders are recorded in the Orders table?
hint: Count the rows that have a numeric OrderID.

title: How many reps?
context: The Reps table starts at column N. HR wants a headcount.
task: How many sales reps are listed in the Reps table?
hint: Count the rep names — they are text, so COUNT alone won't do.

title: Biggest single order
context: Which order shipped the most units?
task: What is the largest number of units on any single order?
hint: Look for the maximum in the units column.

title: Cheapest product to make
context: The Products table (columns J-L) lists each product's cost.
task: What is the lowest product cost in the catalogue?
hint: The Products table has a Cost column.

title: Revenue of one order
context: Order 1001 is in row 2. Revenue is units multiplied by the price each unit sold for.
task: What revenue did order 1001 (row 2) generate?
hint: Combine the units and unit-price cells for that row.

title: Order-size gap
context: Order 1001 is in row 2 and order 1002 is in row 3.
task: How many more units did order 1001 ship than order 1002? (Positive if 1001 is larger.)
hint: Subtract one order's units from the other's.

title: Promo price
context: A promotion takes 10% off the list price.
task: What is the discounted unit price for the order in row 2 after 10% off?
hint: Keep 90% of the original price.

title: Dashboard-ready average
context: The dashboard shows prices to two decimal places.
task: Show the average unit price across all orders, rounded to 2 decimals.
hint: Round the average you computed earlier.

title: Bulk or standard?
context: Fulfilment treats orders of 6+ units as bulk.
task: Label the order in row 2 as "Bulk" if it is 6 units or more, otherwise "Standard".
hint: A single IF with a numeric test.

title: Delivered flag
context: A helper column marks delivered orders with 1 and everything else with 0.
task: Return 1 if the order in row 3 was Delivered, otherwise 0.
hint: Compare the Status cell to the text "Delivered".

title: Delivered orders
context: Ops tracks how many orders actually reached the customer.
task: How many orders have a status of Delivered?
hint: Count the rows whose Status equals Delivered.

title: Large orders
context: Anything over 8 units is treated as a large order.
task: How many orders were for more than 8 units?
hint: Count with a greater-than criterion on units.

title: North region volume
context: The North regional manager wants their unit volume.
task: How many units were sold in the North region?
hint: Sum units, but only for rows where the region is North.

title: Widget volume
context: The Widget product manager wants total volume.
task: How many units of Widget were sold across all orders?
hint: Sum units where the product is Widget.

title: Typical Gadget order
context: How big is a typical Gadget order?
task: What is the average number of units on Gadget orders?
hint: Average units, filtered to Gadget rows.

title: Chart label case
context: Region labels on a chart are shown in capitals.
task: Return the region of the order in row 2 in upper case.
hint: One text function converts case.

title: Name length check
context: Checking whether product names fit a fixed-width label.
task: How many characters are in the product name of the order in row 2?
hint: There is a function for text length.

title: Order label
context: Build a label like "1001 - Service Plan" for the order in row 2.
task: Join the OrderID, a " - " separator, and the product name for row 2.
hint: Use & to stitch the pieces together.

title: Region code
context: Reports use a short 3-letter region code in capitals.
task: Build a 3-letter upper-case code from the region of the order in row 2 (e.g. North becomes NOR).
hint: Take the first three letters, then force upper case.

title: Clean a messy name
context: The rep name in row 6 has stray spaces and inconsistent capitalisation.
task: Return the rep name in row 6 with extra spaces removed and in proper case.
hint: Two nested text functions: one trims, one fixes case.

title: Order year
context: Finance groups revenue by year.
task: In which year was the order in row 2 placed?
hint: Extract the year from the order date.

title: Order month
context: Monthly reporting needs the month number.
task: What month number (1-12) was the order in row 2 placed?
hint: Extract the month from the order date.

title: Days between orders
context: Dates are stored as serial numbers, so subtracting them gives days.
task: How many days passed between the order in row 2 and the order in row 3?
hint: Subtract the two order dates.

title: Build the quarter-end
context: A report is stamped with the Q1 2024 close date.
task: Return 31 March 2024 as a real date value.
hint: Construct it from year, month and day.

title: Category for an order
context: The Products table (J2:L9) maps each product to its Category.
task: Look up the Category of the product sold in order row 2.
hint: Match the product name into the Products table and pull back the Category column.

title: This rep's target
context: The Reps table (N2:Q7) holds each rep's sales Target.
task: Look up the sales target of the rep who owns the order in row 2.
hint: Match the rep name into the Reps table; work out which column the Target is in.

title: Price spread
context: Finance wants the spread between the dearest and cheapest unit price charged.
task: What is the difference between the highest and lowest unit price across all orders?
hint: Subtract the minimum price from the maximum price.

title: North and delivered?
context: A flag marks orders that are both in the North region and delivered.
task: For the order in row 2, return TRUE only if it is in the North region AND its status is Delivered.
hint: Combine two conditions that must both hold.

title: Lost revenue?
context: Cancelled or returned orders count as lost revenue.
task: For the order in row 2, return TRUE if it was Cancelled OR Returned.
hint: Either condition being true is enough.

title: Missing statuses
context: A data-quality check looks for orders with no status filled in.
task: How many orders are missing a Status value?
hint: Count the blank cells in the Status column.

title: Share of total volume
context: How concentrated is volume in the first order?
task: What share of all units sold came from the order in row 2? (Return the fraction.)
hint: Divide that order's units by the total units sold.

title: Odd or even OrderID
context: Alternate-row shading keys off whether the OrderID is even or odd.
task: Return the remainder when the OrderID in row 2 is divided by 2.
hint: The remainder function tells you odd (1) vs even (0).
